name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A public collection of ready-made 'skills' — reusable instructions and workflows — for AI coding agents, pulled straight from one experienced engineer's own daily setup.
buyer: A solo developer or small team adopting Claude Code or Cursor who doesn't want to write every agent skill and workflow from scratch.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer imports it wholesale to instantly upgrade their AI agent setup instead of spending days writing custom skills.
A dev tools startup uses it as a reference implementation when designing their own skill marketplace.
A technical content creator builds a paid course teaching how to customize these skills for a specific stack.

money_ideas.idea: Curate and sell a vetted, organized 'skills starter pack' for specific stacks (Next.js, Rails, etc.) to teams getting started with AI agents.

steal_this: Package a curated, documented subset of these skills for one specific tech stack and sell it as a $20 starter kit this weekend.
